svg.title: Rabbit Carrier Rev D — provisional case placement plan
svg.desc: 60 by 100 millimetre carrier. Landscape LCD active area centered at 30,50. LED wiring exits the top and 12 volt power enters the bottom. Both module USB ports face left. Case aperture, heights and RF envelope require first-article confirmation.

g.text: Centered landscape LCD · top LED exit · bottom power entry
PROVISIONAL CASE STUDY | dimensions in mm | board datum: upper-left (0,0)
Screen UI shown for illustration only
Case reference — confirm against the assembled first article
Estimated LCD face: 18.35 above PCB top with 8.5 mm sockets.
Reserve 20–22 inner depth; verify header engagement and lid clearance.
Provide left-side USB openings and clearance for the actual plug moulding.
Purple hatch: carrier RF exclusions; keep case hardware and wiring clear.
Waveshare's C6 mechanical archive contains an S3-named model: fit is provisional.
DXF: 1:1 mm, board-relative aperture reference; not a finalized enclosure.
